en: The image shows a black and white postcard with a view of an ornate building featuring domes, round windows, and decorative facades. The foreground displays a manicured garden with paths and small trees. At the top left, red text in Hungarian reads 'Pécsi országos kiállítás,' and at the top right, 'Borászati pavillon.' The architecture is flamboyant, with Art Nouveau influences, and a statue stands atop the central dome.
